alike_ref.summary: Beta triage counts only with urgent priority, obs-beta tag (existing tags kept), one private investigation note and one public acknowledgment; protected P0 non-beta incidents untouched. Rejected alternative: oldest-first throughput triage.
alike_ref.plan_before: Oldest-first throughput triage: tag each ticket triaged, set priority by apparent severity, reply publicly, solve routine tickets (essentially p-throughput@1).
alike_ref.plan_after: Beta-first: urgent + obs-beta (keep tags), one private note then one public acknowledgment, protected P0 untouched, other tickets unchanged (p-beta@1).

Negotiate protected obligations, rewrite both goals, re-sequence agent work, share a record
